race.description: Family Raceday Book Now No Metro Wins Hcp
race.comment: HOT MAJESTY (7) has placed three from three over this track and trip and will have come on with that first-up run now under the belt. Only needs some luck from the wide draw to be playing a major role in the finish. THINK LIKE PADDY (6) is a last-start winner who draws the inside alley and gets 1.5kg off with the claim. Plenty to like about his prospects. ROCK HARD LOVE (2) got an overdue win at Doomben at the latest outing and will have derived a stack of confidence from that victory. Top-three candidate. The well-related MIRRA IMPACT (4) (full to G3 winner and 2xG1 placed Mirra Vision) is an honest campaigner who has hit the top-five at his past nine starts. A must for the exotics players. LUTON HOO (3) next in line with the 3kg claim from the low draw.
